A receptor-mediated death signal

An activated lymphocyte expresses Fas ligand and contacts a target cell expressing Fas. Receptor-associated adaptor proteins assemble a death-inducing signaling complex before executioner caspases are activated. Which initiator enzyme is most directly recruited in this pathway?

  1. Lysyl oxidase
  2. Caspase-8
  3. Caspase-9
  4. Catalase
  5. DNA polymerase
Answer and explanation

Caspase-8

Fas signaling activates the extrinsic apoptotic pathway through adaptor proteins and initiator caspase-8.

Option explanations

Caspase-8: Fas signaling activates the extrinsic apoptotic pathway through adaptor proteins and initiator caspase-8.

Caspase-9: Caspase-9 is associated with mitochondrial apoptosome signaling.

Catalase: Catalase detoxifies peroxide.

DNA polymerase: DNA polymerase synthesizes DNA.

Lysyl oxidase: Lysyl oxidase cross-links extracellular matrix proteins.
